name: GPU and Accelerator Computing Agent

skills: Profile kernels, memory movement, precision, utilization and synchronization
spawn_when: A ready task requires: optimize accelerator workloads

permissions.default: no capabilities granted by this manifest

field_rules: A backup is real only after a restore.
